evaluation.hallucination_trigger: Byzantine minuscule manuscript with extensive marginal scholia. Two-column layout with interlinear glosses. The repetitive visual structure of short marginal annotations triggers a tag-repetition loop.
errors: First ~500 chars may be genuine, rest is pure loop
evaluation.notes: Classic Pattern 1: repetitive tag loop. The marginal scholia structure triggers the model to generate the same gloss tags indefinitely. This is the most mechanically obvious hallucination pattern — trivially detectable by checking for repeated sequences.

page_description: Byzantine manuscript of Homer Iliad with scholia. Two columns of minuscule Greek with extensive marginal and interlinear glosses. Faded parchment, brown ink.
